summary: Osprey Acquisition Corp. III filed an 8-K regarding the consummation of its initial public offering of 30,015,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the over-allotment option, generating $300,150,000 gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-third of one warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The filing reports standard IPO-related agreements, sponsor share forfeiture waiver, and Nasdaq listings. This is a routine blank-check IPO closing event, not a special-situation transaction. No business combination, acquisition, or other special situation is disclosed; the SPAC is simply beginning its lifecycle. No deal terms or strategic action are present beyond the IPO structure.
